en.question_text: What change does this sign indicate?
en.answer_a: The start of a zone limited to 20 km/h.
en.answer_b: The start of a pedestrian area.
en.answer_c: The removal of all speed limits.
en.answer_d: The end of a shared zone (zone de rencontre).
en.explanation: Sign B53 indicates the end of the shared zone. Its special rules end; I adapt my speed to the next road and its signs rather than assuming there is no speed limit.
